translations.web: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land, and wrath to this people.
translations.bsb: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers! For there will be great distress upon the land and wrath against this people.
translations.kjv: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.
translations.asv: Woe unto them that are with child and to them that give suck in those days! for there shall be great distress upon the land, and wrath unto this people.
